name: briefing_action_delay_until_progress_tick
description: HudUiBriefingAction_DelayUntilProgress::Tick completes when the briefing progress event code reaches the action threshold.
known_limits: Binary Ninja decompilation exposes x87 comparison details for the float progress threshold test; assembly validates the int-to-float compare and return values.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent briefing action cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x404bb0 validates converting g_Briefing_ProgressEventCode to float, comparing against requiredProgress at action offset 0x04, returning 0 while progress is below threshold and 1 when progress is at or above threshold.
The native smoke invokes the real delay action Tick through its action vtable and validates return 0 below the required progress and return 1 when the event code reaches the threshold.
